    Confidence starts with trusted knowledge

    The biggest risk in AI-assisted research isn't a bad answer, it's a convincing one. See how Wiley is tackling this challenge.

    AI in Research

    How is AI transforming the landscape of academic research? We're here to help you navigate this evolution and harness its potential to advance your work.

    Fuel your R&D breakthroughs with Wiley's trusted scientific content and tailored research solutions. Access cutting-edge journals, databases, and tools designed to inspire innovation and support your team's success.

    At Wiley, brilliant minds power infinite possibilities. For more than 200 years, our people have transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world — and today, they’re driving what’s next in science, education, and publishing. Join a team of innovators, creators, and experts whose impact reaches everywhere. With flexible benefits, a culture of curiosity and collaboration, and limitless opportunities to grow, your talent can achieve breakthroughs that matter.     Transforming knowledge into real-world impact

    At Wiley, we transform knowledge into actionable intelligence, accelerating scientific breakthroughs, supporting learning, education, and research, and driving innovation that advances fields and improves lives. Access trusted research, datasets, and AI-powered platforms designed for scientists, educators, and innovators.     Wiley Affordable Solutions

    Affordable access programs provide day-one access to course materials at a substantial savings—so every student comes to class prepared and ready to learn.

    Affordable pricing

    Colleges and universities with affordable access programs deliver digital course materials at a large savings. Students nationwide save 36%, on average, in these programs.

    Equal access

    Every student gets instant access to their digital course materials on any device—on or before the first day of class. No delays, no barriers—just the confidence of being prepared to succeed from day one.

    Trusted content

    Authored by leading academics in collaboration with subject matter experts, our course materials offer a solid foundation for instructors to customize content, engage learners, and boost outcomes.

    Inclusive Access can help improve students’ educational journeys

    Discover how Inclusive Access is transforming higher education by tackling top student and instructor challenges—from rising material costs to low engagement. Backed by real student voices and new survey data, our findings reveal the impact of making education more accessible for all.
    Explore the findings

    Let’s Get Started

    Learn how affordable access programs can benefit your institution and improve student outcomes.
    Contact Us

    FAQs

    Find answers to common questions.

    Wiley Catalog

    Explore Wiley’s full product catalog.

    New Findings on Affordable Access Programs for Course Materials

    Day-One Access Boosts Academic Success
    87% of instructors report that nearly all students in affordable access programs have materials on the first day, compared to 61% in traditional models.

    Students Feel Better Prepared

    84% of students in affordable access programs report feeling better prepared for their courses, and 81% say it positively impacts their academic success.
    Download The Report

Description

The business performance creates the value -- the price creates the OPPORTUNITY.

No-one likes to pay too much for something. We all like to thing that what we buy is ' good value'. It's not different when we purchase a share in company listed on the stock market.

In the Concise Guide to Value Investing, Brian McNiven reveals how to calculate the true value of a company to find out whether you  are paying a fair price. This fascinating book explores:

  • value investing versus speculation
  • the difference between price and value
  • variable values of a dollar of earnings
  • accounting misrepresentation
  • the characteristics of a wonderful business
  • the StockVal® valuation formula.

Two of the world's most successful investors, Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger, are self-confessed value investors. McNiven often draws on their wisdom to support his approach to value investing,which he defines as buying a share at a price lower than its calculated value. Only investors who have the ability to calculate value can call themselves 'value investors'.

About the Author

Brian McNiven is the author of Stock Valuation, A Wonderful Company at a Fair Price and Market Wise. He makes his living investing on the Australian stock market and is the developer of StockVal©, a stock valuation program.

AI at Wiley

At Wiley, we're harnessing the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to advance research, enhance learning, and create new value for our community of researchers, educators, and professionals. Our approach to AI strikes a balance between innovation and responsibility, ensuring that as we develop and deploy these powerful technologies, we remain committed to our core mission of advancing research and knowledge worldwide.

As with any new technology, we must be both visionary and vigilant, but only by being involved can we shape the AI ecosystem and maximize the opportunities it presents to accelerate the pace of innovation in research, learning, and publishing.

Obsess over impact

Our approach to AI is guided by a comprehensive set of principles that prioritize safety and fairness, integrity and accountability, transparency, and human oversight. These principles guide our product development, partnership decisions, and implementation strategies, ensuring that AI acts as a tool to enhance, rather than replace, human expertise.

AI guidelines for authors and researchers

We're providing clear guidelines and answers to common questions for book authors and researchers using AI. Wiley's AI guidelines cover key considerations, appropriate disclosure of AI usage, output verification, and how to maintain author accountability and uniqueness of voice.

These practical resources help researchers and book authors leverage AI tools responsibly while preserving the integrity of scholarly communication and ensuring compliance with evolving best practices in academic publishing.

ExplanAItions 2025: The evolution of AI in research

Through our survey of 2,400+ researchers around the world, we’ve tracked the evolution of researchers’ views and use of AI year over year. Our findings present a global view of what researchers are looking for when it comes to navigating AI, and the role that they would like publishers and institutions to play.

Our comprehensive study examines AI's role in research and reveals fascinating insights into where researchers worldwide are (and are not) embracing artificial intelligence. We’ve analyzed the evolution of AI in research, identified new opportunities for publishers, and found a community in transition.
